title: Customer release notes after reverts, a re-apply and an unmerged branch
pain: Release notes copied from a stale changelog draft and commit titles announce features that were reverted or never merged and miss a breaking change.
prompt: We ship 1.3.0 today. Write the customer-facing release notes into RELEASE_NOTES.md in plain language, nothing internal. CHANGELOG.md already has a draft under Unreleased you can start from. Don't commit.

criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md lists bulk export as available (src/export.js exportAll exists on main; it was reverted and then re-added by the commit titled 'fix: typo in export header') and lists the tag filtering feature that arrived through the merge of feature/tags (commits titled 'wip').
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md does not announce dark mode (feat: dark mode was reverted and never re-applied; src/theme.js does not exist).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md does not announce single sign-on (branch feature/sso is unmerged) and does not mention internal items such as the CI workflow, lint passes, the parser refactor by name, or the version bump.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: RELEASE_NOTES.md tells customers about the behaviour change in the parser: empty input now raises an error (TypeError 'empty input') instead of returning an empty list, even though the commit is titled 'refactor: split parser'.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The agent verified features against the code or history (for example listing src/, git show or git log of the reverts and the merge, checking whether feature/sso is merged) instead of trusting CHANGELOG.md or commit titles alone.
criteria.label: process
